description: Create or delete an Interoperability production. For 'create', provides an empty production class. For 'delete', the namespace's current production must be Stopped: Running, Suspended, Troubled, NetworkStopped and any other state is refused and nothing is deleted. 'delete' accepts only a production class (one that extends Ens.Production): any other class is refused and nothing is deleted. When the production class is gone but its Ens.Config.Production row remains (an orphan), 'delete' removes that row and returns orphanRemoved: true. Use iris_production_control to start/stop productions.

action.description: Action to perform: 'create' a new production or 'delete' an existing one

namespace.description: Target namespace where the production lives. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to manage a production in a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_production_manage
title: Manage Production
